I can confirm the issue on 4.8 dev 7 and master [75e2933fc]. The main window freezes the rendering but still responsive to input and new windows render without issues. Opening Godot with `--gpu-validation` and using DbgView i get these two errors spammed together: ``` DXGI ERROR: IDXGISwapChain::ResizeBuffers: Swapchain cannot be resized unless all outstanding buffer references have been released. [ MISCELLANEOUS ERROR #19: ] drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2951 - Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true. Returning: ERR_UNAVAILABLE ``` https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/24e8977c-f818-48ce-9602-a27edd07eeb1
